definitions.gloss: stumping; touring to give political speeches
definitions.explanation: Traveling from place to place to give speeches, especially by a politician during an election campaign. Note the unusual reading ぜい of the second kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遊説|ゆうぜい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister set out on a campaign tour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遊説|ゆうぜい}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A candidate is giving a campaign speech in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{期間中|きかんちゅう}→期間中：23950_kikanchuu⟧、⟦{党首|とうしゅ}→党首：17742_toushu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遊説|ゆうぜい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}えた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: During the election period, the party leader toured the country asking for support.

notes:
A news and politics word. The second kanji is normally read せつ (as in ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧), but here it is ぜい, which learners often misread as ゆうせつ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{街頭|がいとう}→街頭：19431_gaitou⟧{遊説|ゆうぜい}: campaigning with street speeches
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遊説|ゆうぜい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stump around the country
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧{遊説|ゆうぜい}: campaigning on behalf of another candidate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧: a speech — the speech itself, wherever it is given
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}{運動|うんどう}→選挙運動：26087_senkyoundou⟧: election campaigning in general
